notes.title: Mystery of the Malign is now released!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571993/e296ab63e9fb77dbb8b313c63cd2df5ffd44513b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The detective game that puts the investigation completely in your hands is now available for you to enjoy.[/p][p]Do you have what it takes? Are you prepared to comb through the information, navigate the falsehoods, unearth the secrets, and ultimately get to the truth?[/p][p]You're welcome to try.[/p]

notes.title: Mystery of the Malign is releasing on September 22nd!
notes.content: [p]Can you feel it? The winds are blowing in. The sun is vanishing behind the trees. It was always an inevitability.[/p][h2]The date is written in stone. September 22nd is the day Mystery of the Malign is coming.[/h2][p]Can you piece together this strange circumstance on your own?[/p][p]Sharpen your wits, open your eyes, and don't forget your Case Notebook. The unknown does not hold back, and neither should you. The less you know going in the better, but suffice to say: prepare yourself for a tangled interconnected web of questions and information that will demand observation, attention, and initiative to get through. The Goddard Museum and its secrets will be yours to dig up and unravel.[/p][p][/p][p]Remember, it’s not necessarily the most skilled detective that gets the job done, but the most dedicated.[/p][p][/p][p]And sincere thanks to everyone who supported Mystery of the Malign during its development![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571993/a20655ade4ab2d8720897bdac82b12e67f80eac9.png"][/img][/p]
